element.name: enable
element.description: Enable neighbor for this address family

element.name: <seconds>
element.description: Reconnect interval in seconds after active connection failure

element.name: <hold-time>
element.description: Hold time in seconds (must be greater than keepalive)

element.name: source-interface
element.description: Bind outbound source address from interface

element.name: <if-name>
element.description: Source interface name (dynamic candidates from IF module)

element.name: ebgp-multihop
element.description: Allow eBGP neighbor not directly connected

element.name: <qp-route-key>
element.description: QP route key, e.g. dqpn=1000,ip=10.99.99.0/24 or dqpn=1000,ipv6=2001:db8::/64

element.name: all
element.description: 监控全部 BGP 邻居

element.name: <ip-address>
element.description: 指定监控的邻居 IP 地址
